item.title: Registration for Summer Camps Opens Today!
item.description:
Registration for Summer Camps Opens Today

Registration for community center, therapeutic recreation and specialty summer camps opens today! 

Resident registration begins at noon, and registration for the general public begins at 7 p.m.

Spots fill up quickly so registering online is recommended; if you need to register in person, you can do so at your local community center.

A few important reminders:

  • If you’ve not used ACTIVENet, the online registration system, since December, you will need to reset your password.
  • Review all of your personal information in ACTIVENet to ensure it's accurate. Review this information for each family member.

View more summer camp information online.

We can't wait to see your child at camp!

View Summer Camp Details

PLAY Scholarships: Making Camps Accessible

The PLAY Scholarship Fund was created to help eligible families with children 18 years and younger participate in fee-based programs offered through Columbus Recreation and Parks Department.

In 2026, each child will be eligible for up to $150 in scholarship support for the year, with awards provided based on eligibility. Scholarships can be used for summer camp* as well as sports, aquatics and community center programs offered by the department throughout the year.

How to Apply

  1. Log into ACTIVENet.
  2. Search for your camps by name or activity number.
  3. When you’re filling out the information for each camp, answer Yes to the question “Do you want to apply for a PLAY Scholarship?” Then, add the camp to your shopping cart.
    • Reminder: Each child is eligible for up to $150 in PLAY Scholarships per year, and scholarships are not guaranteed. You can use the PLAY Scholarship for camp after one week of camp is paid for.
  4. Repeat for each camp and each child.
  5. Once you have added all of your camps, click Checkout.
  6. In your Cart, update your contact information and add your payment information.
    • If you would like to sign up for a payment plan, make sure the box is checked (it will default to this option). A credit card must be on file. Your credit card will be charged an initial payment of $20 per camp. Payments will be deducted from your account beginning on the first Friday in April, and charged weekly until your balance is paid in full.
  7. Once you’re registered, you will receive an email with information about how to upload required camp documents in ePACT; these documents will include proof of eligibility for the PLAY Scholarship. It can take 24 hours to receive that email.
  8. Upload your camp documents in ePACT.
    • Please note: You are encouraged to upload the proof of eligibility document for the PLAY Scholarship as soon as possible so the scholarship can be applied to your account before payments start being deducted from your credit card for your payment plan. We cannot guarantee approved scholarships will be applied by the first Friday in April if you submit your proof of eligibility after March 13; approved scholarships will be credited upon processing.
    • If you don’t upload all other documents such as medical forms at the same time, please remember to do that before camp begins.
  9. If you are awarded a scholarship, the scholarship will be added to your account and the balance due will be adjusted. You will be notified that your balance has been adjusted.

Find more information about eligibility and how to apply online. If you have questions or need help with an application, please contact us at 614-645-3337 or ColumbusRecParks@columbus.gov.

*Please note, the PLAY Scholarship can be applied to summer camp after the first week of camp is paid for.

Learn More About PLAY

item.title: PLAY Scholarships: Making Programs and Camps Accessible
item.description:
PLAY Scholarships: Making Programs and Camps Accessible

We are excited to offer $150,000 in PLAY Scholarship funding for 2026. This enables no less than 1,000 children to be eligible.

In 2026, each child will be eligible for up to $150 in scholarship support for the year, with awards provided based on eligibility. Scholarships can be used for summer camp as well as sports, aquatics and community center programs offered by the department throughout the year. Please note: the PLAY Scholarship can be applied to summer camp after the first week of camp is paid for.

You can find more information online at ColumbusRecParks.com/PLAY. If you have questions or need help with an application, please email ColumbusRecParks@columbus.gov.

We hope to see your child at camp or a community center soon!

Frequently Asked Questions

Who is eligible for a PLAY Scholarship? The PLAY Scholarship is a needs-based scholarship for children up to age 18 whose family is at 80 percent or below the HUD income limit.

If I have more than one child enrolled, can each child receive assistance? Yes. Families with multiple children are eligible to apply for each child.

Is the $150 limit per session or for the entire year? Each child can receive up to $150 for the year.

Will my scholarship be less than $150? Not all applications will be approved. Not every scholarship will be for the maximum amount of $150.

What can I use the PLAY Scholarship for? Scholarships can be applied to any Columbus Recreation and Parks Department summer camp, as well as sports, aquatics and community center programs offered by the department throughout the year.

How do I apply for the PLAY Scholarship, and when do I need to apply? For summer camp, register for summer camp, then visit any community center to apply; be sure to bring proof of eligibility. To apply for a PLAY Scholarship for sports, aquatics and community center programs, apply in person at your local community center prior to registration; be sure to bring proof of eligibility.

What documentation do I need to apply? You will need to provide a copy of your most recent federal income tax return (or the previous year if the current year isn’t available). If you are not required to file a federal income tax return, you may submit any of the following:

  • Copy of current Medicaid eligibility
  • SNAP Benefit statement or Free or Reduced Lunch approval statement
  • Proof of receiving Franklin County Social Services

How will I know I was awarded a scholarship? A scholarship credit will be added to your child’s ACTIVENet account.

Who can I talk to if I need help with the application or documentation? Please email ColumbusRecParks@columbus.gov. You can also talk with the staff at your local community center.

Can I combine the PLAY Scholarship with other assistance? Yes. PLAY Scholarships can be combined with external financial assistance programs such as scholarships. Families will need to apply for this support on their own and will receive the awarded funds – the department will not collect those funds. Once you receive the funds, you can make a payment on your account in ACTIVENet.

Should I wait to register for camp until I find out if I received a scholarship? You should register at the beginning of the registration window to secure your spot in camp.

Will I lose my spot in camp if I don’t get a scholarship? You will not lose your spot in camp if you’re not awarded a scholarship, and you can set up a payment plan if needed. You are guaranteed camp enrollments for sessions that have been paid in full.

Are there payment options if I can’t pay for camp all at once? Payment plans can be set up in ACTIVENet during registration. Payment plans require a credit card to be on file; automatic payments will be charged to your credit card beginning on the first Friday in April and are charged weekly every Friday until the balance is paid in full. Cash payments can be made at your local community center or Columbus Recreation and Parks Department's administrative offices at 1111 E. Broad St.

item.title: Get Ready for Summer Camp!
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Get Ready for Summer Camp!

While the weather is cold and snowy, summer is just around the corner!

Registration for Columbus Recreation and Parks Department's summer camps begins later this month. Camps operate from June 8-Aug. 14. Register for one week or all summer.

Make sure you're ready! Here's what to do: 

  1. Review all of the camps being offered, and plan out your summer. There are a wide variety of camps featuring arts, crafts, sports, games, science experiments and nature exploration.
  2. Review and update your information in ACTIVENet. Make sure your child's information and your contact information is current. If you've not used ACTIVENet since the system was upgraded in December, you'll also need to update your password.
  3. Register for camps beginning later this month. Check out the schedule below - spots fill quickly so be sure to register as soon as registration opens. 

Please note: Capacity continues to be limited, so register as soon as possible. If you don't get into your selected camp at the beginning of registration, be sure to join the waitlist - we hope to open more spots. 

Visit ColumbusRecParks.com/Camps for complete information, including camp themes, residency information and hours. If you have any questions, you can reach us at CRPD_Camps@columbus.gov or 614-645-3337.

We can't wait to see you this summer! 

Registration Schedule

Outdoor Recreation Camps

  • Online: Thursday, Feb. 19 | Columbus residents: 12 p.m. | General public: 7 p.m.
  • In-person: Thursday, Feb. 19 | 12 p.m. | Wyandot Lodge (3228 Indian Village Road)
